kind: The guided account draft (apps/web/app/account/drafts/guided-request.tsx) now saves itself 2 seconds after the last edit, through the existing save path. The Save draft button stays. No schema, route, migration, switch or provider change.
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. The public-home spec line for P-04 is amended by the Conductor in a records change.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main after PR 277. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
changedFiles: apps/web/app/account/drafts/guided-request.tsx: debounced autosave (2000 ms quiet period) calling the existing persist(); one save in flight at a time (the shared flight guard); an edit made during a save stays unsaved and is saved next; the version and 409 handling is unchanged; a status line with aria-live polite and lang en.
tests/operator/v3-guided-request-ui.spec.ts: P-04a to P-04e appended. No existing test changed.

decisions.neverOver: Autosave does not run while the draft is in conflict, closed, or while another request is in flight, and does not run for a form that has validation problems (a blank new draft is not saved until it is valid).
decisions.noLoop: After a failed or refused automatic save the same form is not retried; the next edit makes a new form and tries again. The existing command id reuse for an unchanged retry is kept.
decisions.acknowledgement: Autosave never touches the send acknowledgement. The tick is local state, starts unticked, and is only read by Send. The save body's literal acknowledged field is the existing draft schema requirement and is sent exactly as before by the manual save.
decisions.noSendNoStatusChange: Autosave only calls the draft save action. P-04e asserts no request is sent and no draft is closed.
decisions.focus: Autosave does not use the busy state, so fields stay enabled and focus is not lost while typing; Save draft, Send and Discard are disabled for the moment a save is in flight.
decisions.versions: Each automatic save writes a new draft version, as a manual save does. One version per quiet period; no cap was changed.
